context_requirements: Functional AHR signaling with ARNT available
Expression of AHR in the cell line
AHR ligand that is not rapidly metabolized before 6 h
For CYP1A1/1B1 induction, hepatic or bronchial-like metabolic competence enhances response
falsifiers: No induction of TIPARP, CYP1A1, CYP1B1, AHRR, or NFIL3 at 6 h in any responsive line
No dose-dependent or time-dependent AHR target gene signature
AHR target induction in lines lacking AHR expression
No antiproliferative or cell-cycle transcriptional changes at 24 h despite strong AHR target induction

evidence.supports: Skatole, a partial AHR agonist, induces CYP1A1/2 and CYP1B1 in primary human hepatocytes and HepG2 cells in an AHR-dependent manner.
The AHR agonist 3-methylcholanthrene suppresses DNA synthesis and arrests human umbilical vascular endothelial cells at G0/G1.
TCDD, a potent AHR agonist, alters circadian rhythms, quiescence, and clock gene expression in murine hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells.
The non-dioxin AHR agonist leflunomide protects ischemic-reperfused kidney with reduced apoptosis and inflammatory cytokine expression.
A non-toxic AHR agonist, tranilast, inhibits breast cancer stem-like cells and mammosphere formation.

changes: Removed CDKN1A from proximal_down because AHR activation induces CDKN1A (p21) rather than repressing it; it remains in late_up.
Removed CDKN1A from proximal_down to avoid a gene appearing in both an up and a down list at the same time.
